args.body: Proposed change in src/notifications/rollup.ts: ensure the weekly rollup schedule correctly evaluates recipient local times across date boundaries and timezones such as Sydney so that Monday summaries arrive on Monday instead of Tuesday.
args.title: Fix weekly rollup delivery time for timezones across date boundaries

result: Opened draft pull request 18 from repomind/issue-4204 for issue 4204.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts
The weekly rollup schedule relies on server-time hourly ticks rather than timezone-aware scheduling or evaluating recipient local times properly across date boundaries, causing users in timezones like Sydney to receive their Monday summaries on Tuesday.
